name: What type of paint is best suited for a Level 5 drywall finish?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint is best suited for a Level 5 drywall finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Level 5 drywall finish is versatile and accommodates almost any paint type, but it truly shines with high-gloss, semi-gloss, or dark-colored paints. These finishes, due to their reflective nature or deep pigmentation, tend to magnify any underlying surface imperfections. With a Level 5 finish, the uniform surface prevents shadows and inconsistencies, allowing the true beauty and depth of these paints to be fully realized. Low-sheen or flat paints also benefit, as they achieve a perfectly smooth base, but the difference is most dramatic with more demanding finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Level 5 drywall is best suited for high-gloss, semi-gloss, or dark-colored paints, as it prevents imperfections from showing through.
